ValidationRule.description: Prevent from changing opportunity stage backwards in stage 6 or 7. Only System Admin Profiles will be able to. #21200- deactivating the VR as it is duplicate
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin', $Profile.Name <> 'IME_Custom Sys Admin',
ISCHANGED(StageName),
OR (ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Postponed"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "0 - Pre-Qualification"),ISPICKVAL(StageName, "1 - Qualification"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "2 - Solution Developed"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "3 - Solution Agreed"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "4 - Negotiate"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "5 - Signed/PO In")),
OR (ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE (StageName), "6 - Setup"), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE (StageName), "7 - Closed"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Lost"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Dead")),
NOT(OR(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Lost"), ISPICKVAL( StageName, "Dead")) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Admin - You do not have the authority to change the stage of this opportunity.
